messages:
alex_chen: Hey team — AcmeCloud asked for our SOC 2 report + a bridge letter so they can start a short POC tomorrow. They also want temporary access to a narrow set of logs/evidence. Can Legal/Sec confirm what we can share and how fast?

olivia_legal: Hi — we can do a bridge letter (temp acknowedgement) and a redacted SOC 2 snapshot. Need customer full legal name and the scope of evidence they want.

alex_chen: Customer name: AcmeCloud Inc. POC scope: API keys, request/response logs for a 2-week eval, and basic account config. They will sign our standard NDA first.

maria_gonzalez: Security here — short checklist: (1) confirm NDA signed by Acme legal, (2) list of specific logs they need (date ranges), (3) we only provide redacted SOC2 and selected evidence extracts via secure link, (4) no raw production DB exports.

olivia_legal: Thanks Maria. @alex_chen send me the signed NDA PDF and I'll draft the bridge letter. Bridge letter will: acknowledge we maintain SOC 2 Type II, state the audit period, confirm controls in-scope, and permit temporary limited access to evidence extracts for a defined window. Expiry 30 days from issuance unless extended.

raj_patel: FYI from ops — we can generate an evidence bundle and drop in a pre-signed S3 link. Need exact list: request logs (api-requests), auth logs (auth-events), and config snapshots. Also confirm redaction rules (PII removal).

alex_chen: Will request NDA and exact evidence list from Acme now. For redaction, they asked for user IDs but not emails. Is that OK?

maria_gonzalez: User IDs OK. We'll remove emails, IPs, and any customer content fields. We'll also hash IDs if they ask.

soc2-bot: Uploaded redacted_SOC2_2024_v1.pdf to secure bucket: https://redwood-secure.example/soc2/redacted_SOC2_2024_v1.pdf (access: restricted)

olivia_legal: Draft bridge letter outline (short):
```
Redwood Inference Bridge Letter — Temporary Evidence Access
Date: <date>
Recipient: AcmeCloud Inc.
Summary: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report covering period <start> to <end>. This letter acknowledges temporary limited access to specified evidence extracts for the sole purpose of AcmeCloud's POC, subject to executed NDA and Redwood's redaction policies. Access valid until <expiry>.
```

olivia_legal: I'll attach that to an email once NDA arrives. Alex — send NDA and requested fields to legal@redwood.com and cc me.

emily_wu: Quick note on logistics — we should mark the evidence bundle as 'read-only' and time-limited. Ops: create link with 7-day expiry by default, extendable if legal approves.

raj_patel: Will do. I'll prepare a 7-day pre-signed link and include a manifest file with which files are included.

alex_chen: Got it — pinging Acme legal now. I'll post the signed NDA here when they return it. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

(20 minutes later)
alex_chen: Acme legal uploaded signed NDA. Attaching here -> Acme_NDA_signed.pdf

olivia_legal: Received. I'll finalize the bridge letter and send back for internal review.

maria_gonzalez: Once bridge letter is signed, sec/ops will push the evidence bundle and share the secure link. Let me know if Acme asks for a longer window.

alex_chen: They asked to start the POC tomorrow morning. Can we make the link available by 09:00 PT?

raj_patel: Yes, I'll aim to have the bundle ready and the pre-signed link shared by 08:30 PT.

olivia_legal: Bridge letter drafted and sent to Acme (cc internal). Subject: Temporary Evidence Access — Redwood Inference.

alex_chen: Awesome — closing the loop. Will update if Acme requests more access. Thanks team. :pray:
